hypothesis: Same build as exp-rayon-io, re-measured on the boxes as they are now. The boxes were idle-stopped and restarted (likely new physical hosts) between exp-rayon-io and the CPU-feature runs, whose c8g gains (~2.5%) did not stack. If this re-measure also lands near 6.55s on c8g, those gains were host change.
llm_commentary: Same-host re-measure of the unchanged exp-rayon-io build: c8a 4.67s and c8i 5.49s match their earlier values, but c8g is 6.45s [6.44/6.50/6.41] vs 6.72s before the box idle-stopped and restarted, i.e. the Graviton4 host itself is ~4% faster. Against this same-host baseline the post-restart c8g levers do not help: THP 6.46s (≈0), +sha3 6.56s, native CFLAGS 6.54s and full native 6.55s (each ~1.5% slower, ranges 6.49-6.60 vs 6.41-6.50). Their earlier "wins" were the host change. Every c8g delta that spans an idle stop/start (exp-cursor-maxperf, exp-layout-flag, exp-rayon-io on c8g) is therefore unconfirmed; x86 results are stable across restarts. base-bare-recheck gives a same-host cumulative number.
